description: Price Drop Back. Every store covered, plus card price protection. For requests like "which stores give you money back if the price drops?" or "does my credit card have price protection?". With country=GB, lists the UK policies.

country.description: Two-letter country code. GB (or UK) lists only stores with a UK policy. Default from the request.
